params.name: api-names
params.description: Contains the name(s) of the target Service API(s). Each Service API name shall be set to the value of the <apiName> placeholder of the target Service API URI structure as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122 [14].

params.name: api-versions
params.description: Contains the major version(s) (e.g., v1) of the target Service API(s). Each Service API version shall be set to the value of the <apiVersion> placeholder of the target Service API URI structure as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122 [14]. The key of the map shall be set to the value of the Service API name (i.e., the value of the <apiName> placeholder of the Service API URI structure as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122 [14]) of the Service API to which the provided list of Service API version(s) provided within the map value applies.

params.name: comm-type
params.description: Contains the communication type supported by the target Service API(s).

params.name: protocols
params.description: Contains the protocol(s) supported by the target Service API(s).

params.name: data-format
params.description: Contains data format supported by the target Service API(s).

params.name: api-cats
params.description: Contains the category(ies) of the target Service API(s).

params.name: preferred-aef-loc
params.description: Contains the preferred location information for AEF(s) exposing the target Service API(s). This query parameter is ignored by the CCF if there are no matching records at the CCF.

params.name: api-prov-names
params.description: Contains the name(s) of the provider(s) of the target Service API(s).

params.name: api-supported-features
params.description: Contains the list of the features supported by the target Service API(s) identified by  the api-name query parameter. This query parameter may be present only if the api-name query parameter is also present. The key of the map shall be set to the value of the Service API name (among the ones provided within the api-names query parameter) of the Service API to which the provided list of supported feature(s) provided within the map value applies.

params.name: service-kpis
params.description: Contains iInformation about service characteristics provided by the target  Service API(s).

params.name: api-ids
params.description: Contains the identifier(s) of the targeted Service APIs.

params.name: res-ops
params.description: Contains the list of supported Service API resource(s) and service operation(s). This query parameter may be present only if the api-names query parameter is present.

params.name: supported-features
params.description: Contains the list of supported features among the ones defined in clause 8.11.6. This query parameter shall be present only when feature negotiation is required.

items.docs: Request Open discovery of the Service API(s) according to a set of filtering criteria.
